title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC tip — else we would be born more sinners than Adam (double habitual)
pass_a_gloss: Tip reductio: otherwise we would be born more sinners than Adam was—only his actual and habitual imputed to him, but to us both of those plus a like habitual actually infused and inherent (innate corruption is sin to be imputed unto death unless forgiven). Tip before equity/Martyr.
pass_b_english: Otherwise we would be born from Adam more sinners than Adam was. For to him was imputed only his own actual and habitual sin; to us both would be imputed as to Adam, and besides there would be imputed a habitual sin of the same kind actually implanted and inherent in us—for, like it or not, innate corruption is sin, and unless forgiven is to be imputed unto death.
source_text: Alioqui magis peccatores ex Adamo nasceremur quam fuit Adam. Nam ei non est imputatum nisi ipsius peccatum actuale & habituale; nobis idem utrumque, quemadmodum Adamo, imputaretur, & praeterea imputaretur idem specie peccatum habituale nobis actu insitum ac inhaerens: nam, velis nolis, corruptio innata peccatum est, nisi condonetur, imputandum ad mortem.

choices.choice: Else born more sinners than Adam; tip before equity

notes: Cap. IX inhaerentia densify section 652 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 355–356 tip).
